raw_discovery_candidates.name: Polymarket Perps: maker-incentive farming and event-driven positioning (new venue)
raw_discovery_candidates.one_line: Market-make or trade the perps venue launched 2026-09-03: $75k/day maker rewards, maker rebate at top tier, 20% referral, shared pUSD margin with prediction positions.
raw_discovery_candidates.mechanism: Perps on crypto, equities, indices and commodities run on a CLOB with funding; liquidity rewards of $75,000/day are split evenly across markets and scored as maker_share^0.35 x active_liquidity^0.65 x uptime, counting only two-sided quotes within 20 bps (full weight inside 5 bps, $100k notional cap per tier/side), with a 1% share-of-7-day-maker-volume eligibility floor and a 25% cap. Fees: taker 4 -> 2 bps, maker 1.25 bps -> -0.5 bps rebate by 30-day volume. Early leaders are 'event driven' (FOMC, earnings); one apparent MM firm trades dozens of times a day. Even split across markets means less-traded listings (e.g. single-name semis) carry the same pool as BTC.
raw_discovery_candidates.edge_source: Launch-phase incentives and thin competition; cross-margin lets a prediction-market book hedge delta in-venue.
raw_discovery_candidates.why_might_beat_market: Even-split pools reward whoever quotes neglected markets; early programmes on new venues are typically over-paid relative to risk.
raw_discovery_candidates.failure_modes: 20 bps band on volatile underlyings = toxic flow from CEX-latency arbs; eligibility floor excludes small makers; incentives will be cut; new-venue operational and oracle/mark-price risk; no public PnL evidence yet.
raw_discovery_candidates.cheap_validation: Record perps books vs Binance/NYSE references for two weeks; estimate adverse selection inside 5 bps and the reward per $ of qualifying liquidity in the least competitive markets.
raw_discovery_candidates.flags: Leverage product availability varies by jurisdiction.
raw_discovery_candidates.adjacent_grounding: Only venue documentation exists so far; no independent study of this programme was found in this session.

raw_discovery_candidates.name: Polymarket Perps: rewards-subsidised market making and cross-venue funding or basis arbitrage
raw_discovery_candidates.one_line: A perps CLOB launched 2026-09-03 with $75k per day in LP rewards, 24/7 equity and commodity perps, and hourly funding. Build an early-venue maker and basis desk against Hyperliquid, Binance or CME.
raw_discovery_candidates.mechanism: Quote two-sided within 20 bps of mid. The weights are 1.0 inside 5 bps, 0.25 from 5-10 bps and 0.10 from 10-20 bps, with a $100k cap per tier per side. The score is maker_share^0.35 x active_liquidity^0.65 x uptime. Sides are combined by harmonic mean. Eligibility needs at least 1% of 7-day maker volume. The pool is $75k per day, split evenly across markets, so thin markets pay the most per dollar quoted. Hedge the delta on a deeper venue. Separately, run the funding basis. Funding is hourly: a premium index sampled every 5 s on a $1,000 impact notional, a 0.01% per 8h interest leg, scale 1.0 for crypto and 0.5 for others, and a cap of +/-4% per hour. It runs through weekends while equity underlyings are closed and index feeds switch to overnight or weekend sources. Fees run from 4 bps taker and 1.25 bps maker down to 2 bps and -0.5 bps.
raw_discovery_candidates.edge_source: New-venue subsidy, an immature maker set, and structural funding and weekend-gap dislocations. Rewards are split evenly per market whatever the volume.
raw_discovery_candidates.why_might_beat_market: The venue is 17 days old as of 2026-09-20. Beta accounts got top fee tiers. The top-traded names include unusual Asian semiconductors (SK Hynix, Samsung, Micron) that few crypto market makers hedge well.
raw_discovery_candidates.adjacent_grounding: Hyperliquid, dYdX and CEX liquidity-mining and funding arbitrage. Weekend-CFD pricing by retail brokers.

raw_discovery_candidates.name: Perps liquidity rewards: $75,000 per day split evenly across markets
raw_discovery_candidates.one_line: Quote Polymarket Perps in the least-contested instruments, because the daily $75k pool is divided equally per active market regardless of its volume.
raw_discovery_candidates.mechanism: Polymarket Perps (pUSD-margined perpetuals on indices, commodities, crypto and equities; not available from the US or Canada) pays $75,000 per day, distributed evenly across active markets, with each market's pool shared by score: raw_score = maker_score^0.35 x active_liquidity_score^0.65 x uptime. Maker score is trailing 7-day maker share capped at 25%; active liquidity is deep, balanced resting size within 20 bps of mid; uptime is the share of snapshots with qualifying two-sided quotes. An account (or rewards entity) must hold at least 1% of trailing 7-day maker volume to qualify; self and intra-entity trades do not count. Periods run 12:00-12:00 UTC and pay daily in pUSD. Base fees are 4 bps taker / 1.25 bps maker, with a 20 ms taker delay, a dead-man's-switch auto-cancel and an MM gateway allowing 16 concurrent websocket posts. Hedge on Hyperliquid or a CEX.
raw_discovery_candidates.edge_source: Equal per-market split means reward per unit of competing liquidity is highest in obscure instruments (single equities, commodities) where large crypto MMs are less active; the 0.65 exponent favours posted depth over traded volume.
raw_discovery_candidates.why_might_beat_market: A new venue with a fixed daily budget and, per its changelog, still-changing thresholds; a small team can reach 1% maker share in a thin instrument.
raw_discovery_candidates.failure_modes: The 1% maker-share floor and pay-to-play maker fee until very high tiers; non-crypto instruments have session gaps and index-source risk (changelog notes a correction for Hyperliquid-sourced indices); hedging venues for equity/commodity perps are limited; budget can be cut.
raw_discovery_candidates.cheap_validation: Pull /v1/info/instruments and exchange-stats per instrument, compute $75k / N markets against each market's 7-day maker volume to find where 1% share is cheapest, then paper-quote one instrument for a week.
raw_discovery_candidates.flags: Geo-restricted: no order placement from US, Canada and sanctioned regions; builders must verify user location.

raw_discovery_candidates.name: Perps funding / basis arbitrage and open-interest rewards against Hyperliquid and CEXs
raw_discovery_candidates.one_line: Hold delta-neutral positions between Polymarket Perps and an external perp venue to collect funding differentials on a young book, with an open-interest reward on top for accounts above $5M gross OI.
raw_discovery_candidates.mechanism: Polymarket Perps funding is charged hourly: F_8h = scale x (mean premium + clamp(0.01% - mean premium, +/-0.05%)), hourly rate = F_8h/8 clamped at +/-4%, scale 1.0 for crypto and 0.5 for non-crypto, premium sampled every 5 s on a 1,000-notional impact price. A new venue with retail-heavy directional flow tends to show persistent premium, so shorting rich Polymarket perps against a long on Hyperliquid/Binance (or the reverse) harvests the funding spread; some Polymarket indices are themselves Hyperliquid-sourced, which reduces basis noise. The changelog shows a separate open-interest reward whose eligibility floor was raised from $1M to $5M combined daily average gross OI in September 2026, which delta-neutral carry positions would count toward (terms otherwise undocumented). Base taker fee is 4 bps; liquidation uses an insurance fund then ADL.
raw_discovery_candidates.edge_source: Immature funding market plus venue incentives for holding OI; cross-venue margin and operational capability are the barrier.
raw_discovery_candidates.why_might_beat_market: Funding convergence across established venues took years; first months of a venue are typically the richest.
raw_discovery_candidates.failure_modes: OI reward floor of $5M is out of reach for small teams; ADL can close the hedge leg's counterpart without notice; pUSD/Polygon funding loop versus external venue collateral; referral and fee tiers favour incumbents; programme details undocumented.
raw_discovery_candidates.cheap_validation: Log hourly funding for every Polymarket perp versus Hyperliquid for a month from public market-data endpoints and compute net carry after 4 bps entry/exit and financing.
